subject: math
description: Identify complementary events, calculate complement probabilities, and explain results in context.
learningObjectives: Identify an event and its complement in words and notation.
Use P(A) + P(not A) = 1 to calculate complement probabilities.
Find complement counts from a total group and event count.
Explain complement probabilities using correct context and boundary language.
prerequisites: Convert among fractions, decimals, and percents
Identify a total group or sample space
Subtract decimals, fractions, and whole numbers
